# Celtis strychnoides Planch.

First published in Ann. Sci. Nat., Bot., sér. 3, 10: 306 (1848)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is N. Western Australia to NW. Queensland. It is a tree and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

# Celtis philippensis Blanco

First published in Fl. Filip.: 197 (1837)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is Tropical & Subtropical Asia to N. Australia. It is a tree and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
